authorization: Researcher prioritizes decoding phase transitions and correction thresholds in the continuing Lab 008 study.
question: Does the shortest-then-lexicographic residual crossing selector admit a size-uniform average preimage bound from geodesic exchange structure, or a compatible collision-ladder obstruction?
claim_boundary: The bounded order matrix selects shortest-then-lexicographic only as the best finite control. This contract tests its exact structural mechanism before any all-size promotion.
alternatives: Encode every collision preimage by the target, first path divergence and first reconnection, then bound the number of admissible geodesic exchanges under the full charge record.
Prove a local exchange or loop-erasure involution that assigns collision pairs to disjoint witnesses with bounded physical expectation.
Construct a square collision ladder with shortest-path degeneracy and determine whether it carries positive physical majority-domain mass.
planned_steps: Extract exact shortest-selector collision witnesses at L3/L4 and classify first-divergence/reconnection data, path-length degeneracy and nested exchanges.
State the weakest all-size counting lemma sufficient for bounded kappa_L and test every premise on the exact controls.
Stop at a proved geodesic-exchange reduction, a compatible positive-mass ladder obstruction, or a named theorem-hypothesis gap.
acceptance_criteria: The shortest-selector replay exactly recovers kappa_3=11/9 and kappa_4=3113/1605 on the same physical majority domains.
Every collision witness has explicit divergence/reconnection and charge-preservation checks.
Any proposed all-size bound states how witness multiplicity and physical probability are both controlled.
No L3/L4 pattern is extrapolated into a size trend or threshold claim.
stop_rule: Do not enumerate L5, search unrestricted path orders, fit kappa_L, or infer midpoint noncorrectability. Stop after the bounded shortest-selector exchange/obstruction matrix is complete.

observed_findings.two_environment_gap: the colliding paths are shortest-selected in different preimage states; endpoint and length changes invalidate a same-environment geodesic-swap argument
observed_findings.finite_fans: L4 multiplicity-at-least-four targets contain 7528/138030 majority preimages and contribute 33900/267718 of the second moment; eight targets have multiplicity eight
observed_findings.claim_boundary: no scale-stable positive-mass ladder, uniform kappa bound, midpoint noncorrectability or threshold is established

decision: Close the naive closed-geodesic exchange route. The remaining direct target is a uniform summable tail for open boundary-fan multiplicity across two selector environments.
